title: AtkinsRealis
summary: Canadian engineering group with Candu reactor and nuclear-services expertise.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

AtkinsRealis provides nuclear engineering, reactor life-extension and decommissioning services, and holds Candu reactor technology. It supports utilities in Canada and abroad and is involved in advanced-reactor studies. Its engineering and construction segments also serve infrastructure and power clients.

Technology Exposure

  • Candu reactor technology and services
  • Nuclear life extension and decommissioning
  • Engineering and infrastructure

What To Watch

  • Reactor refurbishment programmes
  • New-build decisions
  • Project execution

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
